info.short_description: Median age of the total population.
info.long_description: The median age of all residents in a given geography, derived from ACS Table B01002. This is a commonly used summary statistic for the age structure of a population.
info.statement: In {location}, the median age is {value} years.

info.short_description: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units that have a broadband (high-speed) internet subscription, derived from ACS Table B28002. Includes cable, fiber, DSL, satellite, and fixed wireless connections.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have a broadband internet subscription.

info.short_description: Share of women aged 15–50 who gave birth in the past 12 months.
info.long_description: Proportion of women aged 15–50 years who gave birth in the past 12 months, derived from ACS Table B13002. Used as an approximation of the general fertility rate.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of women aged 15–50 gave birth in the past year.

info.long_name: Opportunity Youth Rate (Ages 16–24, Not in School or Work)
info.short_description: Share of youth aged 16–24 who are neither enrolled in school nor employed.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 16–24 who are not enrolled in school and not employed (sometimes called 'disconnected youth' or 'opportunity youth'), derived from ACS Table B14005.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of youth aged 16–24 are neither in school nor employed.

info.short_description: Share of adults aged 25+ who have at least a high school diploma or equivalent.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 25 and older who have completed high school (including equivalency), derived from ACS Table B15002. Includes all levels of educational attainment at or above high school.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults aged 25+ have at least a high school diploma.

info.short_description: Share of adults aged 25+ who have attended any college or higher.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 25 and older who have some college, an associate degree, a bachelor's degree, or a graduate/professional degree, derived from ACS Table B15002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults aged 25+ have attended college or obtained a higher degree.

info.short_description: Measure of household income inequality (0=perfect equality, 1=maximum inequality).
info.long_description: The Gini index measures the degree of income inequality among households, derived from ACS Table B19083. A value of 0 represents perfect equality; 1 represents maximum inequality. The ACS Gini is based on household income.
info.statement: In {location}, the Gini index of income inequality is {value}.

info.short_description: Share of the total population living in group quarters (prisons, dorms, nursing homes, etc.).
info.long_description: Proportion of the total population residing in group quarters (e.g., correctional facilities, college dormitories, nursing facilities, military barracks), derived from ACS Tables B26001 and B01001.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population lives in group quarters.

info.long_name: Severe Housing Cost Burden Rate (Spending 50%+ of Income on Housing)
info.short_description: Share of households spending 50% or more of income on housing costs.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units where gross housing costs (rent or owner costs) exceed 50% of household income, derived from ACS Tables B25070 (renters) and B25091 (owners). Severe cost burden is a standard HUD threshold indicating serious housing affordability stress.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households are severely cost-burdened, spending 50%+ of income on housing.

info.long_name: Housing Cost Burden Rate (Spending 30%+ of Income on Housing)
info.short_description: Share of households spending 30% or more of income on housing costs.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units where gross housing costs (rent or owner costs) exceed 30% of household income, derived from ACS Tables B25070 (renters) and B25091 (owners). Cost burden at 30% is the standard HUD threshold indicating housing affordability stress.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households are cost-burdened, spending 30%+ of income on housing.

info.short_description: Total resident population count.
info.long_description: Total resident population, derived from ACS Table B01001.
info.statement: In {location}, the total population is {value}.

info.short_description: Total count of males in the population.
info.long_description: Count of males in the total resident population, derived from ACS Table B01001.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} males.

info.short_description: Total count of females in the population.

info.short_description: Total count of infants aged 0–4 years.
info.long_description: Count of children aged 0–4 years (infants and toddlers) in the resident population, derived from ACS Table B01001.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} children aged 0–4 years.

info.short_description: Total count of children and adolescents aged 5–17 years.
info.long_description: Count of children and adolescents aged 5–17 years (school-age youth) in the resident population, derived from ACS Table B01001.

info.short_description: Total count of young adults aged 18–39 years.

info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} young adults aged 18–39 years.

info.short_description: Total count of middle-aged adults aged 40–64 years.
info.long_description: Count of middle-aged adults aged 40–64 years in the resident population, derived from ACS Table B01001.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} middle-aged adults aged 40–64 years.

info.short_description: Total count of seniors aged 65 years and older.
info.long_description: Count of older adults aged 65 years and older in the resident population, derived from ACS Table B01001.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} seniors aged 65 and older.

info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is male.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as male, derived from ACS Table B01001.

info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as female, derived from ACS Table B01001.

info.long_description: Share of the resident population aged 0–4 years, derived from ACS Table B01001.

info.short_description: Proportion of the population aged 5–17 years.

info.short_name: Young adult share of population (18–39 years)
info.short_description: Proportion of the population aged 18–39 years.

info.short_name: Middle-aged adult share of population (40–64 years)

info.long_description: Share of the resident population aged 40–64 years, derived from ACS Table B01001.

info.long_name: Share of Population Aged 65 and Older (Seniors)
info.short_description: Proportion of the population aged 65 years and older.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population aged 65 years and older, derived from ACS Table B01001.

info.short_description: Ratio of dependents (ages 0–17 and 65+) to working-age adults (ages 18–64).
info.long_description: Ratio of the combined count of young (0–17 years) and older (65+) dependents to the working-age population (18–64 years), derived from ACS Table B01001. A higher ratio indicates a greater relative burden on the working-age population.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} dependents for every working-age adult.

info.short_description: Count of Non-Hispanic White residents.

info.short_description: Count of Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander residents.

info.long_description: Count of residents who identify as Non-Hispanic and of two or more races, derived from ACS Table B03002.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} Non-Hispanic residents identifying as two or more races.

info.short_description: Count of Hispanic or Latino residents of any race.
info.long_description: Count of residents identifying as Hispanic or Latino of any race, derived from ACS Table B03002.

info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Non-Hispanic White.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic White alone, derived from ACS Table B03002.

info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Non-Hispanic Black or African American.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic Black or African American alone, derived from ACS Table B03002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Non-Hispanic Black or African American.

info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Non-Hispanic American Indian and Alaska Native.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic American Indian and Alaska Native alone, derived from ACS Table B03002.

info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Non-Hispanic Asian.

info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Non-Hispanic Asian.

info.long_name: Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander Share of Total Population
info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone, derived from ACS Table B03002.

info.long_name: Non-Hispanic Two or More Races Share of Total Population
info.short_description: Proportion of the population identifying as Non-Hispanic two or more races.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic and of two or more races, derived from ACS Table B03002.

info.long_name: Hispanic or Latino Share of Total Population
info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Hispanic or Latino.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Hispanic or Latino of any race, derived from ACS Table B03002.

info.short_description: Probability that two randomly chosen residents are from different racial/ethnic groups (0=no diversity, ~1=maximum diversity).
info.long_description: Herfindahl-based diversity index computed as 1 minus the sum of squared race/ethnicity shares across seven groups (Non-Hispanic White, Black, Asian, Hispanic, Native American, Pacific Islander, Two or more races), derived from ACS Table B03002. A value near 0 means nearly all residents share one group; a value near 1 means population is evenly distributed across all groups.
info.statement: In {location}, the race-ethnicity diversity index is {value}.

info.short_description: Share of family households headed by a single parent with children.
info.long_description: Proportion of family households that are headed by a single parent (male or female householder, no spouse present) with children under 18, derived from ACS Table B11012.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of family households are headed by a single parent.

info.long_name: Crowded Housing Rate (More Than 1 Person per Room)
info.short_description: Share of occupied housing units with more than 1 person per room.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units with more than 1 person per room (a standard indicator of housing crowding), derived from ACS Table B25014.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of housing units are crowded (more than 1 person per room).

info.long_name: Rate of Housing Units Lacking Complete Plumbing Facilities
info.short_description: Share of housing units without complete indoor plumbing.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units that lack complete plumbing facilities (hot and cold running water, a bathtub or shower, and a flush toilet), derived from ACS Table B25048.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of housing units lack complete plumbing facilities.

info.long_name: Rate of Occupied Housing Units Without Telephone Service
info.short_description: Share of occupied housing units without telephone service.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units with no telephone service available (neither landline nor cellular), derived from ACS Table B25043.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have no telephone service.

info.short_description: Share of housing units that are mobile homes or trailers.
info.long_description: Proportion of all housing units that are mobile homes, manufactured homes, or trailers, derived from ACS Table B25024.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of housing units are mobile homes.

info.short_description: Share of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied (homeownership rate), derived from ACS Table B25003.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of occupied housing units are owner-occupied.

info.short_description: Share of the population with income below the federal poverty level.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population with family income below the federal poverty threshold, derived from ACS Table B17001.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population lives below the poverty level.

info.short_description: Share of workers who commute primarily by public transportation.
info.long_description: Proportion of workers aged 16 and older who use public transportation (excluding taxicab) as their primary means of commuting to work, derived from ACS Table B08301.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of workers commute primarily by public transportation.

info.long_name: Deep Poverty Rate (Below 50% of Federal Poverty Level)
info.short_description: Share of the population with income below 50% of the federal poverty level.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population with income below 50% of the federal poverty threshold (deep poverty), derived from ACS Table C17002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is in deep poverty (below 50% of the poverty level).

info.long_name: Near-Poverty Rate (Below 150% of Federal Poverty Level)
info.short_description: Share of the population with income below 150% of the federal poverty level.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population with income below 150% of the federal poverty threshold, derived from ACS Table C17002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population has income below 150% of the poverty level.

info.long_name: Low-Income Rate (Below 200% of Federal Poverty Level)
info.short_description: Share of the population with income below 200% of the federal poverty level.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population with income below 200% of the federal poverty threshold, derived from ACS Table C17002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population has income below 200% of the poverty level.

info.short_description: Share of households receiving SNAP (food stamp) benefits.
info.long_description: Proportion of households that received Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP, formerly food stamps) benefits in the past 12 months, derived from ACS Table B22003.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households receive SNAP benefits.

info.short_description: Median value of owner-occupied housing units in dollars.
info.long_description: Median self-reported value of owner-occupied housing units in current dollars, derived from ACS Table B25077.
info.statement: In {location}, the median home value is ${value}.

info.long_name: Rate of Households Without Internet Access
info.short_description: Share of households without any internet access.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units with no internet subscription of any kind, derived from ACS Table B28002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have no internet access.

info.long_name: Median Earnings for Full-Time, Year-Round Workers
info.short_description: Median earnings for full-time, year-round workers in dollars.
info.long_description: Median earnings for full-time, year-round civilian workers aged 16 and older in current dollars, derived from ACS Table B20017.
info.statement: In {location}, the median earnings for workers is ${value}.

info.short_description: Median household income in the past 12 months in dollars.
info.long_description: Median household income in current dollars, including all sources of income for all household members, derived from ACS Table B19013.
info.statement: In {location}, the median household income is ${value}.

info.short_description: Mean income per person in dollars.
info.long_description: Per capita income computed by dividing total aggregate income by the total population, derived from ACS Table B19301.
info.statement: In {location}, the per capita income is ${value}.

info.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the lowest 20% of households.
info.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the lowest income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.

info.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Second Quintile
info.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the second 20% of households.
info.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the second income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.
info.statement: In {location}, the second income quintile receives {value} of total income.

info.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Third Quintile
info.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the middle 20% of households.
info.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the third (middle) income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.
info.statement: In {location}, the middle income quintile receives {value} of total income.

info.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Fourth Quintile
info.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the fourth 20% of households.
info.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the fourth income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.
info.statement: In {location}, the fourth income quintile receives {value} of total income.

info.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Highest (Fifth) Quintile
info.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the highest 20% of households.
info.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the highest income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.
info.statement: In {location}, the highest income quintile receives {value} of total income.

info.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Top 5%
info.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the top 5% of households.
info.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the top 5%, derived from ACS Table B19082.
info.statement: In {location}, the top 5% of households receive {value} of total income.

info.short_description: Ratio of income share of the top 20% to the bottom 20% of households.
info.long_description: The S80/S20 ratio is computed as the share of aggregate income held by the top quintile divided by the share held by the lowest quintile, derived from ACS Table B19081. A higher ratio indicates greater income inequality.
info.statement: In {location}, the income quintile share ratio (S80/S20) is {value}.

info.short_description: Share of the population aged 5+ who speak English less than 'very well'.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population without health insurance.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with no health insurance coverage of any type, derived from ACS Table B27001.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is uninsured.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian labor force that is unemployed.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian labor force (aged 16+) that is unemployed and actively seeking work, derived from ACS Table B23001. The numerator includes unemployed civilians; the denominator includes all civilians in the labor force.

info.long_name: Civilian Noninstitutionalized Population with a Disability Rate
info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with any disability.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with any disability (hearing, vision, cognitive, ambulatory, self-care, or independent living), derived from ACS Subject Table S1810. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population has a disability.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population covered by Medicare.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with Medicare health insurance coverage, derived from ACS Subject Table S2704. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is covered by Medicare.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population covered by Medicaid or other means-tested public insurance.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with Medicaid or other means-tested public health insurance coverage, derived from ACS Subject Table S2704. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is covered by Medicaid.

info.long_name: Percent of County Population Living in Urban Areas (2020 Census)
info.short_description: Share of county population residing in Census-defined urban areas.
info.long_description: Proportion of a county's 2020 Census population living within Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas and urban clusters combined). Derived from the 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File by summing each county's urban-area population share across all intersecting urban areas. Counties with no urban area are assigned 0. Values are 2020 Census vintage and do not vary by year.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population lives in urban areas.

info.long_name: Percent of County Land Area Classified as Urban (2020 Census)
info.short_description: Share of county land area within Census-defined urban areas.
info.long_description: Proportion of a county's total land area that falls within Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas and urban clusters combined). Derived from the 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File. Counties with no urban area are assigned 0. Values are 2020 Census vintage and do not vary by year.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the land area is classified as urban.

info.long_name: Percent of County Housing Units in Urban Areas (2020 Census)
info.short_description: Share of county housing units located in Census-defined urban areas.
info.long_description: Proportion of a county's 2020 Census housing units located within Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas and urban clusters combined). Derived from the 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File. Counties with no urban area are assigned 0. Values are 2020 Census vintage and do not vary by year.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of housing units are in urban areas.

info.short_description: Share of addresses that self-responded to the 2020 Census, among all addresses (not just those invited to self-respond).
info.long_description: From the Census Bureau's 2020 Census Operational Quality Metrics (Release 4), the percent of all addresses in the county resolved via self-response (by internet, phone, or mail) rather than nonresponse followup. Static 2020 vintage; will not update again until the 2030 Census. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_census_participation measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of addresses self-responded to the 2020 Census.

info.short_description: Total county resident population from the Census Bureau's Population Estimates Program.
info.long_description: Annual postcensal population estimate for the county, summed from single-year-of-age counts in the Population Estimates Program (PEP) characteristics file. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_population measure.
info.statement: In {location}, the estimated population is {value}.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Age 65 and Older (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population age 65 or older.
info.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 65 and up, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_65_and_older measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is age 65 or older.

info.short_description: Share of county population under age 18.
info.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 0-17, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_below_18_years_of_age measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is under age 18.

info.long_name: Percent of Population that is Female (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identified as female.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for the 'Female' sex category, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_female measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is female.

info.long_name: Percent of Population American Indian or Alaska Native Alone (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as American Indian or Alaska Native alone, of any Hispanic origin.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 006 (American Indian and Alaska Native alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_american_indian_or_alaska_native measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is American Indian or Alaska Native.

info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Asian alone, of any Hispanic origin.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 012 (Asian alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_asian measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Asian.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander Alone (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone, of any Hispanic origin.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 050 (Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Black or African American Alone, Not Hispanic (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 453 (Black or African American alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_black measure.

info.short_description: Share of housing units that are mobile homes or trailers.

info.short_description: Share of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied.

info.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Third Quintile

info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population without health insurance.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with no health insurance coverage of any type, derived from ACS Table B27001.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is uninsured.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian labor force that is unemployed.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian labor force (aged 16+) that is unemployed and actively seeking work, derived from ACS Table B23001. The numerator includes unemployed civilians; the denominator includes all civilians in the labor force.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the civilian labor force is unemployed.

info.long_name: Civilian Noninstitutionalized Population with a Disability Rate
info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with any disability.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with any disability (hearing, vision, cognitive, ambulatory, self-care, or independent living), derived from ACS Subject Table S1810. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population has a disability.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population covered by Medicare.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with Medicare health insurance coverage, derived from ACS Subject Table S2704. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is covered by Medicare.

info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population covered by Medicaid or other means-tested public insurance.
info.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with Medicaid or other means-tested public health insurance coverage, derived from ACS Subject Table S2704. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is covered by Medicaid.

acs_AGE.short_description: Median age of the total population.
acs_AGE.long_description: The median age of all residents in a given geography, derived from ACS Table B01002. This is a commonly used summary statistic for the age structure of a population.
acs_AGE.statement: In {location}, the median age is {value} years.

acs_BDB.short_description: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription.
acs_BDB.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units that have a broadband (high-speed) internet subscription, derived from ACS Table B28002. Includes cable, fiber, DSL, satellite, and fixed wireless connections.
acs_BDB.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have a broadband internet subscription.

acs_BTH.short_description: Share of women aged 15–50 who gave birth in the past 12 months.
acs_BTH.long_description: Proportion of women aged 15–50 years who gave birth in the past 12 months, derived from ACS Table B13002. Used as an approximation of the general fertility rate.
acs_BTH.statement: In {location}, {value} of women aged 15–50 gave birth in the past year.

acs_DCY.long_name: Opportunity Youth Rate (Ages 16–24, Not in School or Work)
acs_DCY.short_description: Share of youth aged 16–24 who are neither enrolled in school nor employed.
acs_DCY.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 16–24 who are not enrolled in school and not employed (sometimes called 'disconnected youth' or 'opportunity youth'), derived from ACS Table B14005.
acs_DCY.statement: In {location}, {value} of youth aged 16–24 are neither in school nor employed.

acs_EDB.short_description: Share of adults aged 25+ who have at least a high school diploma or equivalent.
acs_EDB.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 25 and older who have completed high school (including equivalency), derived from ACS Table B15002. Includes all levels of educational attainment at or above high school.
acs_EDB.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults aged 25+ have at least a high school diploma.

acs_EDC.short_description: Share of adults aged 25+ who have attended any college or higher.
acs_EDC.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 25 and older who have some college, an associate degree, a bachelor's degree, or a graduate/professional degree, derived from ACS Table B15002.
acs_EDC.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults aged 25+ have attended college or obtained a higher degree.

acs_GNI.short_description: Measure of household income inequality (0=perfect equality, 1=maximum inequality).
acs_GNI.long_description: The Gini index measures the degree of income inequality among households, derived from ACS Table B19083. A value of 0 represents perfect equality; 1 represents maximum inequality. The ACS Gini is based on household income.
acs_GNI.statement: In {location}, the Gini index of income inequality is {value}.

acs_GRP.short_description: Share of the total population living in group quarters (prisons, dorms, nursing homes, etc.).
acs_GRP.long_description: Proportion of the total population residing in group quarters (e.g., correctional facilities, college dormitories, nursing facilities, military barracks), derived from ACS Tables B26001 and B01001.
acs_GRP.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population lives in group quarters.

acs_HBS.long_name: Severe Housing Cost Burden Rate (Spending 50%+ of Income on Housing)
acs_HBS.short_description: Share of households spending 50% or more of income on housing costs.
acs_HBS.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units where gross housing costs (rent or owner costs) exceed 50% of household income, derived from ACS Tables B25070 (renters) and B25091 (owners). Severe cost burden is a standard HUD threshold indicating serious housing affordability stress.
acs_HBS.statement: In {location}, {value} of households are severely cost-burdened, spending 50%+ of income on housing.

acs_HBU.long_name: Housing Cost Burden Rate (Spending 30%+ of Income on Housing)
acs_HBU.short_description: Share of households spending 30% or more of income on housing costs.
acs_HBU.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units where gross housing costs (rent or owner costs) exceed 30% of household income, derived from ACS Tables B25070 (renters) and B25091 (owners). Cost burden at 30% is the standard HUD threshold indicating housing affordability stress.
acs_HBU.statement: In {location}, {value} of households are cost-burdened, spending 30%+ of income on housing.

acs_REX.short_description: Probability that two randomly chosen residents are from different racial/ethnic groups (0=no diversity, ~1=maximum diversity).

A value near 0 means nearly all residents share one group; a value near 1 means population is evenly distributed across all groups.
acs_REX.statement: In {location}, the race-ethnicity diversity index is {value}.

acs_WWN.long_name: Rate of Households Without Internet Access

acs_WWN.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units with no internet subscription of any kind, derived from ACS Table B28002.
acs_WWN.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have no internet access.

acs_INB.long_name: Median Earnings for Full-Time, Year-Round Workers
acs_INB.short_description: Median earnings for full-time, year-round workers in dollars.
acs_INB.long_description: Median earnings for full-time, year-round civilian workers aged 16 and older in current dollars, derived from ACS Table B20017.

acs_INC.short_description: Median household income in the past 12 months in dollars.

acs_INC.statement: In {location}, the median household income is ${value}.

acs_PCI.statement: In {location}, the per capita income is ${value}.

acs_INL.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Lowest (First) Quintile

acs_INL.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the lowest income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.
acs_INL.statement: In {location}, the lowest income quintile receives {value} of total income.

acs_INM.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Second Quintile
acs_INM.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the second 20% of households.

acs_INN.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Third Quintile

acs_INO.long_name: Share of Aggregate Household Income: Fourth Quintile
acs_INO.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the fourth 20% of households.
acs_INO.long_description: Proportion of total aggregate household income received by households in the fourth income quintile, derived from ACS Table B19082.

acs_INP.short_description: Share of aggregate household income received by the highest 20% of households.

acs_OWS.statement: In {location}, the income quintile share ratio (S80/S20) is {value}.

acs_MCR.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is covered by Medicare.

acs_MCD.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population covered by Medicaid or other means-tested public insurance.
acs_MCD.long_description: Proportion of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with Medicaid or other means-tested public health insurance coverage, derived from ACS Subject Table S2704. Note: not available for all geographies or all vintage years.

census_ur_pct_urban_pop.long_name: Percent of County Population Living in Urban Areas (2020 Census)
census_ur_pct_urban_pop.short_description: Share of county population residing in Census-defined urban areas.
census_ur_pct_urban_pop.long_description: Proportion of a county's 2020 Census population living within Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas and urban clusters combined). Derived from the 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File by summing each county's urban-area population share across all intersecting urban areas. Counties with no urban area are assigned 0. Values are 2020 Census vintage and do not vary by year.
census_ur_pct_urban_pop.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population lives in urban areas.

census_ur_pct_urban_land.long_name: Percent of County Land Area Classified as Urban (2020 Census)
census_ur_pct_urban_land.short_description: Share of county land area within Census-defined urban areas.
census_ur_pct_urban_land.long_description: Proportion of a county's total land area that falls within Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas and urban clusters combined). Derived from the 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File. Counties with no urban area are assigned 0. Values are 2020 Census vintage and do not vary by year.
census_ur_pct_urban_land.statement: In {location}, {value} of the land area is classified as urban.

census_ur_pct_urban_hu.long_name: Percent of County Housing Units in Urban Areas (2020 Census)
census_ur_pct_urban_hu.short_description: Share of county housing units located in Census-defined urban areas.
census_ur_pct_urban_hu.long_description: Proportion of a county's 2020 Census housing units located within Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas and urban clusters combined). Derived from the 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File. Counties with no urban area are assigned 0. Values are 2020 Census vintage and do not vary by year.
census_ur_pct_urban_hu.statement: In {location}, {value} of housing units are in urban areas.

pep_population.short_description: Total county resident population from the Census Bureau's Population Estimates Program.
pep_population.long_description: Annual postcensal population estimate for the county, summed from single-year-of-age counts in the Population Estimates Program (PEP) characteristics file. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_population measure.

pep_pct_65_older.long_name: Percent of Population Age 65 and Older (PEP)
pep_pct_65_older.short_description: Share of county population age 65 or older.
pep_pct_65_older.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 65 and up, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_65_and_older measure.
pep_pct_65_older.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is age 65 or older.

pep_pct_under_18.short_description: Share of county population under age 18.

pep_pct_under_18.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is under age 18.

pep_pct_female.long_name: Percent of Population that is Female (PEP)
pep_pct_female.short_description: Share of county population identified as female.
pep_pct_female.long_description: PEP population estimate for the 'Female' sex category, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_female measure.
pep_pct_female.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is female.

pep_pct_aian.long_name: Percent of Population American Indian or Alaska Native Alone (PEP)

pep_pct_aian.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 006 (American Indian and Alaska Native alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_american_indian_or_alaska_native measure.

pep_pct_asian.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Asian alone, of any Hispanic origin.
pep_pct_asian.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 012 (Asian alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_asian measure.
pep_pct_asian.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Asian.

pep_pct_nhpi.long_name: Percent of Population Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander Alone (PEP)
pep_pct_nhpi.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone, of any Hispanic origin.
pep_pct_nhpi.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 050 (Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander measure.
pep_pct_nhpi.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander.

pep_pct_nh_black.long_name: Percent of Population Black or African American Alone, Not Hispanic (PEP)
pep_pct_nh_black.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
pep_pct_nh_black.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 453 (Black or African American alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_black measure.

pep_pct_nh_white.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 451 (White alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_white measure.

saipe_median_household_income.long_description: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE) modeled median household income (SAEMHI_PT). Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_median_household_income measure.

census_ua_county.name: 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File
census_ua_county.location: 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File (XLSX)
census_ua_county.description: The 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File maps Census-defined urban areas (urbanized areas with population ≥ 50,000 and urban clusters with population 2,500–49,999) to counties. Each row represents a county-urban area intersection and includes the share of county population, land area, and housing units within that urban area. Summing across all urban areas for a county yields total percent urban. Counties not appearing in the file have no urban area and are considered 100% rural. Urban area boundaries are based on the 2020 decennial Census and reflect the updated delineation methodology that increased the minimum population threshold for urbanized areas from 50,000 to 50,000 and revised cluster definitions.
census_ua_county.restrictions: Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

acs5.name: 2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates, Powered by Metopio
acs5.location: Census API — ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables and Subject Tables
acs5.description: Extraction and formatting provided by Metopio, The American Community Survey (ACS) is an ongoing survey conducted by the U.S. Census Bureau that provides detailed demographic, social, economic, and housing data for communities across the United States. The 5-year estimates pool data over a 60-month period, providing greater statistical reliability for small geographic areas (including ZIP Code Tabulation Areas) at the cost of timeliness. Variables cover a broad range of social determinants of health including poverty, housing, education, employment, insurance coverage, and racial/ethnic composition. Data are retrieved via the Census Bureau's public API using the censusapi R package.
acs5.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

pep_charv.name: Population Estimates Program (PEP): Annual Population Estimates by Age, Sex, Race, and Hispanic Origin
pep_charv.description: The Population Estimates Program (PEP) produces annual postcensal estimates of the resident population for the nation, states, and counties by age, sex, race, and Hispanic origin, benchmarked to the most recent decennial census and updated using birth, death, and migration data. Used here as the Census Bureau's own source for county population totals and demographic composition, rather than pulling those figures from a downstream redistribution.
pep_charv.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

saipe.name: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
saipe.description: SAIPE provides annual, model-based estimates of income and poverty for states, counties, and school districts, combining American Community Survey data with administrative records (tax, SNAP, and population data) to improve precision for small geographies. Used here as the direct source for county child poverty rate and median household income.
saipe.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

oqm_2020.name: 2020 Census Operational Quality Metrics
oqm_2020.description: The Census Bureau's Operational Quality Metrics describe how 2020 Census addresses were counted, including self-response rates, online response share, and nonresponse followup resolution, using final processed census data. This is a one-time release tied to the 2020 Census; the next comparable release will follow the 2030 Census.
oqm_2020.restrictions: Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

sahie.name: Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE)
sahie.description: SAHIE provides annual, model-based estimates of health insurance coverage for counties and states by age, sex, race/ethnicity, and income, combining ACS data with administrative health insurance program records to improve precision for small geographies. Used here as the direct source for county uninsured rates.
sahie.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
